verdicts.why: Hernandez phones James and greets his old friend with a hug in S1E11 'Danger Close', where he calls her one of the good ones and they press her about Rawlins. They free Frank with a clean slate in S1E13.
James gives Rawlins the Distinguished Intelligence Medal and offers him the deputy director post in S1E5 'Gunner'. In S1E11 she accepts Russo as the scapegoat on condition that Rawlins resigns.
Hernandez calls Stein by his first name, to Stein's surprise, in S1E4 'Resupply'. They work on who hacked the Greek Mob operation in S1E5 'Gunner'.

In S1E10 'Virtue of the Vicious' Madani names Rawlins to Hernandez and he hands back her badge so she can find evidence against him. He sees Rawlins's body bagged at Micro's hideout in S1E13 'Memento Mori'.

Schoonover appears in The Punisher only in the S1E3 'Kandahar' flashbacks, where he and Rawlins assemble and brief the Cerberus squad. The Schoonover page also says they blamed Frank for the leaked Zubair footage, so the N2 fix is right. Rawlins admits arranging the attack in S1E11.
In S2E3 Pilgrim 'gets away when Madani arrives in a helicopter'. In S2E6 'Pilgrim follows and threatens Madani'.

The Schultzes first appear in the S2E3 flashbacks, which show them paying for his wife's care and sending him on the mission. In S2E11 'The Abyss' Eliza uses his sons as a 'final test' of his loyalty.
Kurse holds Frigga and stabs her in the back with her own sword. Malekith lets him do it.
Kurse, not Malekith, kills Frigga during Malekith's attack, so 'Loki's mother's killer' is wrong. The new line is accurate.

value.text: Malekith fights Thor across the Convergence in Greenwich. Thor slams one of Selvig's teleportation devices into him, Jane sends him to Svartalfheim, and his own ship crushes him there.
value.on_a_card_about_b: The god who defeats Malekith in Greenwich.
value.on_b_card_about_a: The Dark Elf Thor defeats during the Convergence.

verdicts.why: Thor does not kill Malekith himself. Thor drives the last teleportation device into his chest, Jane activates it to send him to Svartalfheim, and Selvig teleports the Ark down to crush him. The proposed text has Thor's blow alone sending him away, so the attribution is fixed here.

value.title: WandaVision#5

value.on_a_card_about_b: Wanda's son, whom Agatha babysits as Agnes.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Babysits Billy as the nosy neighbor Agnes.

split.title: WandaVision#8
split.text: Agatha seizes the boys and chokes them with her magic to force Wanda's hand.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Wanda's son. Agatha babysits him as Agnes, then chokes him to force Wanda.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Babysits Billy as the nosy neighbor Agnes, then seizes him.

verdicts.why: In #5 Wanda and Vision first let Agnes look after the newborn twins, so #5 is right. Agatha does not take the boys hostage until the end of #8 'Previously On' (and still holds them at the start of #9), so that part is split out.

value.text: Years later Agatha helps Billy find Tommy's lost soul, which he places in the body of a drowning boy.

split.on_a_card_about_b: Billy's lost brother, whose soul Agatha helps Billy find. As a ghost, Agatha then searches for him with Billy.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Helps Billy find Tommy's soul, then searches for Tommy as a ghost.

verdicts.why: Agatha helps Billy locate Tommy's soul in #8, and she dies at the end of that episode. Only in #9 do 'Billy and Agatha set out to find Tommy', so the ghost search is split out.
Monica finds the entrance to Agatha's basement and runs into the impostor Pietro at the end of #7. By #9 he has kept her prisoner.
Hayward pulls a gun on the twins and is stopped by Rambeau in #9.
Same scene as above, in #9.
Hayward 'emerge[s] with a firearm and attempt[s] to kill them' in #9. Hayward and the twins have no earlier scene together.
Billy is born in #3, the same episode in which Geraldine says Ultron killed Wanda's twin Pietro. The #6 'Pietro' is the impostor.
Tommy is born and Pietro's death is named in #3. Tommy's inherited super speed is first shown in #6.

split.on_a_card_about_b: Billy's twin brother, made by Wanda's magic.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Tommy's twin brother, made by Wanda's magic.

verdicts.why: The twins are born in #3. They grow up (aging to five, then ten) only in #5, so 'grow up side by side' is split out.
Billy is born to Wanda and Vision in #3, with Vision there.

split.on_b_card_about_a: Wanda's son, made with her magic, whom she has to let go.

verdicts.why: Billy is born in #3, so #3 is right. Wanda says goodbye to the twins as she collapses the Hex in #9, so that part is split out.
Darcy and Jimmy first meet Monica after her expulsion, in #5. Hayward orders all three off the base in #6.

split.on_b_card_about_a: A scientist who mocks Hayward, digs through his files, and rams his car.

verdicts.why: The 'murdered by his own murder squad' jibe, the order off the base and the hack that finds Project Cataract all happen in #6. Darcy rams his Humvee with the food truck in #9, so that part is split out.
Darcy is handcuffed to a Humvee and taken in when Wanda expands the Hex at the end of #6. She appears as the circus escape artist in #7.

split.on_b_card_about_a: An FBI agent Hayward brushes off, who helps foil his plans.

verdicts.why: Hayward dismisses Woo's concerns about sending an agent through the sewers in #4. Woo calls in the FBI, Darcy stops Hayward and he is arrested in #9, so that part is split out.
In #6 Monica opposes Hayward's plan to attack Wanda, he orders her off the base, and she sneaks back to find he has been tracking Vision.

value.text: When Monica enters Westview, Wanda's Hex turns her into "Geraldine," a neighbor who befriends Wanda.

verdicts.why: Wanda befriends Geraldine in #2. Geraldine mentions Ultron and is thrown out of the Hex at the end of #3 (replayed in #4). Monica comes back in to warn Wanda in #7. So the later facts are split out.
Lisa is in the #2 flashbacks and #1 only without Vision. Her first episode with him is #4, where 'With Lisa's help, Vision and Tommy infiltrate a gala'.
In #4 Vision yields control to Ultron, who traps him in the Mindspace and leaves with Tommy. Tommy learns of Ultron only in that episode.
Raza appears in one VisionQuest episode, #6 'Deadlock', where he demands that Paladin hand over the Vision alive.
Sharon Davis as Mrs. Hart comes to dinner in #1 'Filmed Before a Live Studio Audience'. In #5 she appears only in a photo.
She is already under the Hex as Mrs. Hart in #1, where she even breaks character to beg Wanda to stop.
Hayward fires at the twins and Monica stops him in #9.

split.on_b_card_about_a: A boy Vision rescues, then cares for like a son.

verdicts.why: Vision finds Tommy at Saint Mabyn's and gets him away from Paladin in #2. Their bond as father and son is built only in #3, where Vision struggles to bond with him and then reassures him that he is real, so that part is split out.
The twins are born in #3, and Wanda lets them go as the Hex collapses in #9.

value.title: WandaVision#5
value.text: Tyler Hayward's S.W.O.R.D. has held Vision's body since his death, and Hayward shows footage of Wanda taking it from S.W.O.R.D.
value.on_a_card_about_b: The dead Avenger whose body Hayward holds.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Holds Vision's body after his death.

split.title: WandaVision#8
split.text: Hayward refused to let Wanda bury Vision and spent years trying to rebuild him as a S.W.O.R.D. weapon. Using energy from Westview, he brings him back as the White Vision.
split.on_a_card_about_b: The dead Avenger Hayward rebuilds as the White Vision.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Takes Vision's body and rebuilds him as a weapon.

split.on_a_card_about_b: The dead Avenger Hayward rebuilds as the White Vision.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Takes Vision's body and rebuilds him as a weapon.

verdicts.why: The #5 footage and the #8 flashback and reactivation are right. But the White Vision is only switched on in the #8 mid-credits scene and sent against Wanda's Vision in #9, so the proposed #8 split must not carry that sentence. It goes in its own #9 stage.
In #5 Hayward names Wanda the cause and orders the drone strike. Wanda takes the drone out of the Hex, so no missile is fired. The White Vision is turned on in #8 and attacks in #9.
The White Vision is activated in the #8 mid-credits scene. The fight, the memory restoration and his flight all happen in #9.
At the end of #1 'Matinee', Cleary calls Trevor to confirm he has made contact with Simon, whom Cleary calls super powered and dangerous.
